live_url_note: Public Cloudflare quick-tunnel base URL (changes when the tunnel restarts). Fetch {live_url}/data/<file>.json. null when the tunnel is down.
latest_sha_api_note: GET with header 'Accept: application/vnd.github.sha' returns the latest live-data commit SHA as plain text (unauthenticated limit 60 req/hour per visitor IP, cached 60s; send If-None-Match with the last ETag, 304s do not count).
raw_by_sha_note: Files at a commit SHA are never stale (new SHA every push). Branch URLs (github_fallback_base) are cached up to 5 minutes and ignore query strings.
